source.code:
/-- A mixin class with the axiom `‖1‖ = 1`. Many `NormedRing`s and all `NormedField`s satisfy this
axiom. -/
class NormOneClass (α : Type*) [Norm α] [One α] : Prop where
  /-- The norm of the multiplicative identity is 1. -/
  norm_one : ‖(1 : α)‖ = 1
